congo:CG-D-NA.name: Nkéni-Alima
congo:CG-D-NA.note: Reference geometry reconstructed from the 2017 OCHA district polygons using the department membership in Laws 25–27/2024. The 2024 Kintélé and Île Mbamou transfer to Brazzaville is not resolved by this source; nearby Brazzaville and Djoué-Léfini geometry is approximate. Districts are not exposed because post-reform coverage is incomplete.
